caseName: Economic Consultants, Inc. v. Mercury Record Productions, Inc.
caseNameFull: Economic Consultants, Inc., dba E-C Tape Service, Inc. v. Mercury Record Productions, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Wis. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
